question: to the Commission Siegbert Frank Droese (ESN) Subject:

A digital catch certificate system for all fishery products entering the EU, known as CATCH, came into force on 10 January 2026. The ambitious system replaced the previous paper-based process and is considered central to EU efforts to tackle illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing, help protect marine biodiversity and contribute to the EU’s broader efforts to simplify administrative procedures. Will the Commission please list all persons and organisations (e.g. non-governmental organisations, trade organisations, logistics experts and non-EU exporters) that were consulted in any way during the development of the CATCH system?
